rationale: Arya is building agent-first tooling (LeSearch AI for agentic search, LeCoder for mobile control of AI agents) while Jiale has deep expertise in ML infrastructure and distributed training systems at Meta—complementary strengths for scaling agentic systems. Both are in San Francisco and share a systems-level view of AI: Arya from the product/application layer and Jiale from the infrastructure layer that powers large-scale ML platforms.
intro_message: Arya Teja Rudjaraju, meet Jiale Zhi — you're both building in the agentic AI space from different angles (product tooling vs ML infrastructure) and could explore how scalable training systems might unlock the next generation of agent capabilities.
